Flagship Programs

Four systems. One operating philosophy.

Architected, governed, and scaled in high‑stakes, distributed environments — each one a system built to outlast the engagement.

National Expansion · 2021–2023

A national rollout, 60% ahead of roadmap.

Built the program architecture, governance model, and operational infrastructure for a national gig‑aggregation platform — scaling 3 markets to 25+ in nine months.

25+
Markets
2wk
Launch cycle
0
P0/P1
Read the case+

The situation

A mandate to launch nationally with no program infrastructure — no repeatable launch model, no cross‑functional governance, no SLA framework, and a timeline stakeholders had already called unrealistic. Three markets live; the ask was 25+ in under a year.

The approach

Architecture before acceleration — two weeks invested in infrastructure before touching velocity. A repeatable launch framework with decision gates, a full SLA/risk/dependency governance model, and systematic critical‑path compression that cut the cycle from eight weeks to two.

The outcome

25+ markets live with zero P0/P1 incidents, a repeatable playbook adopted as the org standard, and an executive decision layer that replaced ad‑hoc status reporting entirely.

Operational Intelligence · 2021–2023

25 markets. One source of truth.

Designed and built a centralized operational intelligence platform — integrating program data, real‑time dashboards, and executive decision visibility across 25+ markets.

25+
Markets unified
1
Source of truth

Fragmented reports
Read the case+

The situation

Twenty‑five markets, read like 25 separate businesses. KPIs lived in separate tools; executive visibility required slow, error‑prone manual aggregation. Leadership was deciding on data days old.

The approach

An operational architecture decision, not a dashboard project — one platform, three layers: a unified data model as single source of truth, real‑time operations dashboards, and an executive decision surface. Standardization first, audience‑specific views, latency as a hard constraint.

The outcome

Real‑time visibility across 25+ markets, manual aggregation eliminated, and cross‑market trends — previously invisible across siloed reports — turned into actionable signal.

AI & Automation · 2022–Current

Automating everything that doesn't need judgment.

Architected an AI operations layer using Claude and GPT‑4 — automating routing logic, executive reporting synthesis, and market‑readiness scoring across the ops lifecycle.

30–50%
Overhead cut
18%
Cost reduction
3
Agentic domains
Read the case+

The situation

At 25+ markets, the volume of repetitive, rule‑bound decisions — routing, readiness scoring, reporting synthesis — outpaced human latency. The team spent roughly 40% of its time on pattern‑work.

The approach

A unified AI operations layer across three domains: predictive routing, LLM reporting synthesis, and automated market‑readiness scoring across 30+ variables. Built with trust engineering, explicit failure‑mode design, and human‑in‑the‑loop checkpoints — Responsible AI on existing infrastructure.

The outcome

30–50% of manual overhead eliminated, an 18% cost reduction via predictive routing, and a weekly reporting cycle cut from 6–8 hours to automated synthesis with human review.

PMO Architecture · 2021–Current

Built 3+ PMOs from zero. 99%+ SLA.

Established operating models, release governance, SLA frameworks, and portfolio‑level reporting across Series A/B and enterprise environments.

Read the case+

The situation

Across Series A, Series B, and enterprise organizations, the same pattern: strong vision, aggressive targets, and execution infrastructure that couldn't support either. Governance lived in spreadsheets and Slack threads.

The approach

PMO as a layered system, built in sequence — operating model, release governance, SLA framework, and portfolio reporting — each tuned to the organization's actual complexity rather than importing enterprise process into a startup.

The outcome

3+ PMOs built from zero, 99%+ SLA compliance at national scale, and three concurrent programs governed under a unified portfolio model — infrastructure documented to outlast the engagement.

The Dashboard Builds

Where strategy becomes execution.

The live boards, dashboards, and pipelines that run the programs above — the architecture itself, not mockups.

Portfolio governance. Every initiative carries an owner, priority, live status, and timeline — a sprawling program turned into one sortable system of record. The executive visibility layer that replaced ad‑hoc status reporting: program health, dependencies, and accountability readable at a glance.

This is how we narrow the runways. A structured intake‑to‑delivery funnel where every request enters, gets triaged through explicit decision gates, and either advances to active delivery or is parked. Dozens of inbound asks converge to the committed few — the prioritization discipline that compressed a national launch cycle.
